title: Published coefficient/exponent pair (31/10, 1) for the fixed BK/Shoup family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total BK/Shoup family defined in proof.md: f_0=0; for n>=1 choose the least prime k>2*n^(3/5), r=ceil(n/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); fix one deterministic Shoup F_2 irreducible-polynomial algorithm; pad x with zeros into r field blocks, set y_i=phi_i(x)^(2^(i+1)-1), and output the constant coefficient of Sym_r^t(y_1,...,y_r). The fixed algorithm and field basis are as specified in proof.md.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"10","numerator":"31"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"10","numerator":"31"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=(31/10)n-o(n) at every sufficiently large integer length n=|x| in the full Li\u2013Yang B2 model.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: Reproduced-argument claim (unscored, supporting evidence only; does not alter the scored theorem, family, coefficient or exponent above). proof.md's "Independent verification and reproduced argument" section reproduces, from the primary sources rather than by citation alone: (1) BK-preprint Theorem 2.2's exact hypotheses, shown met term-for-term by this family's p=2, m=n instantiation; (2) Shoup-preprint Theorem 3.2's fixed-prime corollary (OCR-verified from the source PDF), the deterministic poly-time field construction this family's evaluator uses; (3) Li-Yang's (LY-full) complexity-measure machinery verbatim -- Definition 3.6's mu=g+alpha_I*i+alpha_Q*q+alpha_phi*Phi, Lemma 3.7/Corollary 3.8's troubled-gate bound (flagged as imported from FGHK16, not re-derived), Theorem 3.9, Lemma 3.11 (normalization), Lemma 3.12 (troubled-pair elimination) and Theorem 4.1's six-floor LP statement -- including an explicit account of why alpha_Q*q does not appear in Theorem 3.9's final bound (q=0 at the R=empty starting measure) while each of Theorem 4.1's six inductive-step floors individually charges or credits alpha_Q against that step's own change in q; (4) a by-hand re-derivation confirming all six LP floors at alpha_phi=1/5, alpha_I=48/5, alpha_Q=9/5, delta=64/5 (five equal 16/5, one is slack at 17/5), delta<=alpha_I+16/5=64/5 tight, and the objective delta-alpha_phi/2-alpha_I=31/10 exactly; (5) fresh SHA-256 re-verification of all three cited source PDFs (LY-full 4530cbaf38f0f9a09704e94f7d1f57109895b71b92d0752a285e07d1109a4062; BK-preprint 922c9a7d3ed8a5b1ceb07056d9a515043cc7e029d12a9529934d7b60a4d9cfbf; Shoup-preprint 00590fb8f0717338530b067626428781991edb840fb74c37cf846f07f50e0644); (6) an ACM DOI 10.1145/3519935.3519976 cross-check that LY-full is the published STOC 2022 paper. The same section also explicitly names what is NOT reproduced: LY-full's full case-by-case proof of Theorem 4.1 (reproduced here only as its six resulting floors plus the general accounting mechanism, not sub-case-by-sub-case) and FGHK16's Lemma 3 (imported, not re-derived).
